byteOrder: target-native; serialization/wire byte order is a separate contract

layouts.aos: one segment; natural field alignment; row stride rounded to maximum field alignment
layouts.soa: one segment per field; scalar stride equals scalar width
layouts.aosoa: one segment of tiles; each field owns tileWidth adjacent scalar lanes; tile stride rounded to maximum field alignment
layouts.soaos: one segment per declared field group; each segment is an array of naturally aligned compact subrecords

aosoa.tails: capacity controls live rows; padded tail lanes are never live entities

soaos.groups: must form an exact, nonempty partition of declared fields; group order and field order are ABI-significant

handles.row: owner + store-domain + slot + generation; never a raw row pointer
handles.structuralMutation: blocked while conflicting field/slice loans exist

compressed32.role: actor-local managed object reference encoding; not ActorRef, native pointer, FFI handle, row handle, or capability
compressed32.storedInWiderCell: all bits above bit 31 must be zero
compressed32.reuse: canonical published object offsets do not recycle within one physical actor lifetime under compressed32-v1

unsupported: unknown scalar/layout/profile or unrepresentable extent must fail before publishing an artifact
